title: Credit Rating
text: The long term and short term credit facilities are rated by CRISIL and the present rating of the Company is CRISIL A-/Stable (Reaffirmed)-Long Term Rating and CRISIL A2+ (Reaffirmed)-Short Term Rating on October 28, 2025.
